rows.note: Use this only for grammatical number, such as a singular noun or pronoun.

example.english: The subject of this sentence is singular.
example.traditional: 呢個句子嘅主語係單數。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 geoi3 zi2 ge3 zyu2 jyu5 hai6 daan1 sou3

rows.note: Use this when singular means strange or unusual in behavior, appearance, or circumstances.

example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 jat6 go3 joeng6 zan1 hai6 gu2 gwaai3

rows.note: Use 獨特 as the all-purpose choice for something distinctive or one of a kind.

example.english: The design of this shop is singular.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 dim3 ge3 cit3 gai3 hou2 duk6 dak6

rows.note: Use this when the person, ability, or achievement is outstanding rather than merely unusual.

example.english: They gave a singular performance this time.
example.traditional: 佢哋今次嘅表現真係出色。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 gam1 ci3 ge3 biu2 jin6 zan1 hai6 ceot1 sik1
